text:
maya-peopleops: FYI we've posted a handbook update under 'Family & Leave' that clarifies who is eligible for paid family leave (includes full-time, pro-rated part-time, and a new 1099 opt-in after 12 months). Please review and complete the brief acknowledgment + microtraining by Mon 2026-04-06. https://handbook.redwood.com/family/eligibility-update

tony-eng: Quick clarifying Q: if someone is 0.6 FTE, how is pay calculated? prorated from annual package or by hours?

maya-peopleops: Good Q — it's prorated from regular base pay by FTE percentage (section called "Proration and Pay Calculation"). We added an example table in the handbook (look for the 0.6 FTE example).

rachel-manager: Are managers required to retake anything or just acknowledge? Also can managers get a list of direct reports who haven't completed it?

maya-peopleops: Managers must complete a 15-min manager runthrough (mandatory). ICs only need the 10-min acknowledgment course. We'll auto-send reminders via LMS and offboarding will block until ack for new leaves. We'll share a completion roster with managers on Tuesday.

training-bot: Reminder scheduled 514 Microtraining assignment will go out tomorrow at 09:00 PT to all active employees. Link to course: https://lms.redwood.com/courses/family-eligibility (auto-assigned)

ton y-eng: Typo 20: 'tony' (fixed) — also: what about people currently on leave? Does this change the terms mid-leave?

maya-peopleops: No changes to leaves already in progress. New eligibility and payment rules apply to leave requests with start date on or after the effective date (2026-04-01). We'll update the FAQ with a retroactive policy note.

li-devex: Can we get a one-paragraph blurb for team channels and for the all-hands announcement? Managers keep asking for a simple script.

maya-peopleops: Draft blurb: "We've updated the Family & Leave handbook page to clarify eligibility and pay proration. All staff: please review the page and complete the short acknowledgment + microtraining by Apr 6. People managers: complete the 15-min manager runthrough. Questions? DM @maya-peopleops." I'll post to #general and email.

rachel-manager: Thanks. Last one: contractors who opt in, how do they sign up?

maya-peopleops: Contractors who meet the 12-month continuous engagement threshold will receive an opt-in link in the LMS. We9ll coordinate with Finance to administer payments via contractor stipends. Edge cases can be flagged to people-ops.

li-devex: :thumbsup: Also: can we surface a short "What to tell your team" bullet list in the page? Managers prefer copy-paste lines.

maya-peopleops: Yep will add a "Manager talking points" section with 3 bullets and a sample Slack blurb.

training-bot: Manager roster export created and emailed to maya-peopleops at 10:12 PT.

maya-peopleops: Cool, thanks everyone. If you run into exceptional cases (e.g., international contracts, local statutory differences), ping me directly and we9ll route to Legal/Comp.

tony-eng: Thanks, putting this in our Friday squad sync.
